english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial term for a young person, including a young man.
Use this when “dude” means a young man being described rather than addressed.

examples.english: That youth always helps the old lady carry groceries.
examples.traditional: 嗰個後生仔成日幫阿婆拎餸。
examples.jyutping: go2 go3 hau6 saang1 zai2 seng4 jat6 bong1 aa3 po4 ling1 sung3

examples.english: That young dude always helps old ladies carry things.
examples.traditional: 嗰個後生仔成日幫阿婆拎嘢。
examples.jyutping: go2 go3 hau6 saang1 zai2 seng4 jat6 bong1 aa3 po4 ling1 je5
